final_text:
I emailed groups@cityhub-tokyo.jp, the group-bookings address from one of City Hub's guest reviews. The hotel is listed as "City Hub" in Tokyo.

The email asks about availability for 10 people in June, along with group rates and booking conditions. You didn't give specific dates, so I left them open. Once they reply, I can help with the next steps.
